name: dev-time-tracker
description: Transform your coding sessions into actionable insights! Dev Time Tracker is a comprehensive productivity companion for developers that automatically tracks your coding time, monitors your health, and provides powerful analytics through a beautiful web dashboard.
author: William Asaba

devtimetracker.apiUrl.description: Base URL of your tracking API

devtimetracker.pomodoro.workDuration.markdownDescription:
Duration of work sessions in **minutes**.

- `25` minutes (default, classic Pomodoro)
- `30` minutes
- `45` minutes

devtimetracker.pomodoro.shortBreakDurati.markdownDescription:
Duration of short breaks in **minutes**.

- `5` minutes (default)
- `10` minutes
- `15` minutes

devtimetracker.pomodoro.longBreakDuratio.markdownDescription:
Duration of long breaks in **minutes**.

- `15` minutes (default)
- `20` minutes
- `30` minutes

devtimetracker.pomodoro.sessionsBeforeLo.markdownDescription:
Number of work sessions before taking a long break.

- `4` sessions (default, classic Pomodoro)
- `6` sessions
- `8` sessions

devtimetracker.pomodoro.autoStartNextSes.markdownDescription:
Automatically start the next session/break when the current one ends.

**Enabled**: Next session starts automatically
**Disabled**: You must manually start each session

devtimetracker.metrics.enabled.description: Enable collection of code metrics and analytics

devtimetracker.metrics.syncInterval.description: Interval in seconds to sync metrics with the backend

devtimetracker.tracking.enableDiffCaptur.markdownDescription:
Enable capturing code diffs for each activity. **Shows what code was added/removed in the dashboard.**

**Enabled**: Full diff tracking with side-by-side view
**Disabled**: Only tracks line counts (less memory usage)

devtimetracker.tracking.enableTerminalTr.markdownDescription:
Track time spent in VS Code integrated terminals. **Note**: Only tracks terminal focus time, not actual commands (for security).

**Enabled**: Terminal activity is tracked and included in your metrics
**Disabled**: Only editor activity is tracked

devtimetracker.health.breakReminderEnabl.markdownDescription: Enable break reminders. **Reminders appear as non-blocking notifications and won't disrupt your workflow.**

devtimetracker.health.breakReminderInter.markdownDescription:
Time in **seconds** between break reminders.

- `1800` = 30 minutes
- `3600` = 60 minutes (default)
- `7200` = 2 hours

devtimetracker.health.breakSnoozeDuratio.markdownDescription:
Snooze duration in **seconds**.

- `600` = 10 minutes
- `900` = 15 minutes (default)
- `1200` = 20 minutes

devtimetracker.health.breakEnableSound.description: Play sound when break reminder appears

devtimetracker.health.postureReminderEna.markdownDescription: Enable posture check reminders. **Helps prevent back pain and improve ergonomics.**

devtimetracker.health.postureReminderInt.markdownDescription:
Time in **seconds** between posture reminders.

- `1200` = 20 minutes
- `1800` = 30 minutes (default)
- `3600` = 60 minutes

devtimetracker.health.postureSnoozeDurat.markdownDescription:
Snooze duration in **seconds**.

- `600` = 10 minutes
- `900` = 15 minutes (default)
- `1200` = 20 minutes

devtimetracker.health.postureEnableSound.description: Play sound when posture reminder appears

devtimetracker.health.eyeStrainReminderE.markdownDescription: Enable eye strain reminders. **Follows the 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds.**

devtimetracker.health.eyeStrainReminderI.markdownDescription:
Time in **seconds** between eye strain reminders.

- `1200` = 20 minutes (default, follows 20-20-20 rule)
- `1800` = 30 minutes
- `3600` = 60 minutes

devtimetracker.health.eyeStrainSnoozeDur.markdownDescription:
Snooze duration in **seconds**.

- `300` = 5 minutes
- `600` = 10 minutes (default)
- `900` = 15 minutes

devtimetracker.health.eyeStrainNotificat.description: Notification style for eye strain reminders

devtimetracker.health.eyeStrainEnableSou.description: Play sound when eye strain reminder appears

devtimetracker.customReminders.markdownDescription:
Add custom reminders.

Example:
```json
[
  {
    "title": "Commit Code",
    "message": "Don't forget to commit your changes",
    "interval": 1800,
    "enabled": true
  }
]
```

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:vsce && npm run publish:ovsx
